name: idlecrash
description: Crash with fake tokens against other people who are also waiting for Claude: in a pane on a terminal, in the browser elsewhere.

serverUrl.title: Server URL
serverUrl.description: The IdleCrash server everyone plays on. Change it only to use your own.

nickname.title: Nickname
nickname.description: Shown to other players. Empty means a random Guest name.

autoOpen.title: Open when Claude starts working
autoOpen.description: Open the IdleCrash pane by itself at the start of every turn.

browser.title: Where to open the game
browser.description: auto: the app's browser panel when there is one, else your default browser. app: only the panel. system: always your default browser.
